output.summary: A perennial herb naturally distributed across Europe, non-tropical Asia, North Africa and Australia, it has a red-tinged stem base and fleshy, sour edible leaves. It is eaten cooked or in salads, but its oxalic acid content means moderation is advised, especially for people with kidney problems, rheumatism or gout.
